answer_span_consistency.note: passed: no text immediately precedes the response slot

target_fidelity.note: Positive active imperative with no modal.

naturalness.note: The dark-room context coherently motivates the instruction.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice producing an imperative.

determinacy.note: The cue and context sufficiently specify the expected response.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: All vocabulary is common and transparent.
